style: 1970s-2008 Indian highway cloverleaf grade separator: concrete decks on pier-and-cap bents, 1 m parapets, two levels (the loop ramps and the straight flyover over them), black-and-white painted kerbs

height.of: lamp heads and gantry boards over the upper deck (deck level 13 m by the G-150 rule)
height.source: estimated: deck heights are the world's own estimate (G-150); lamp posts 7 m on 1 m parapets
height.chosen_because: OSM carries no heights; the model's top is the lamp heads over the 13 m upper deck.

facts.en: A cloverleaf grade separator built under the NHDP at the junction of the Grand Southern Trunk Road, Inner Ring Road, Anna Salai and Mount-Poonamallee Road.
The main span linking the Inner Ring Road and the Grand Southern Trunk Road opened on 9 April 2008 and the rest on 26 October 2008.
The junction was a roundabout with a statue of Jawaharlal Nehru before the flyover.

references_withheld: No photograph was used: the model is drawn from the world's own road decks (OSM centre lines, G-150 heights) and general knowledge of Indian highway flyover details.

collision.plan: Jolt boxes for lamp posts and gantry posts; the decks, parapets and piers keep the chunk builder's colliders (DeckMeshes).

peace_zone.reason: none: a road junction, not a place to stand (data only)
